description: Customer support platform and infrastructure for human and AI agent collaboration across multiple communication channels.
auth_notes: API access uses private app keys / bearer tokens generated within the Plain workspace.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account/plan on Plain and create private app keys self-serve.
api_notes: Offers a comprehensive GraphQL/REST API to interact with threads, customers, events, and custom actions for connected AI agents.
mcp_notes: No official vendor-published MCP server found directly in the standard documentation, though community integrations or custom implementations may exist.
rationale: Plain provides self-serve free developer access and a well-documented API allowing external agents to integrate natively.
